{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained negative sentiment (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 values) and model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if true outcome consistently exceeds model forecast in the last 5-7 days (indicating overconfidence or lag).",
    "Apply upward correction if model underestimates true price after a recent spike (e.g., forecast < 70.0 while true > 72.0) and sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Use sentiment as a momentum filter: if sentiment > 0.5 in last 3 days, model should not overreact to short-term volatility; cap forecast increases at 3-5% above recent high.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, apply mean reversion: if model forecast is > 10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 10-15% to avoid overextension.",
    "If true outcome shows sharp upward movement (e.g., > 5% from prior day) and model fails to catch it, increase forecast by 2-5% to align with sentiment momentum.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.67 or higher, model should not underestimate price — apply a 3-5% upward bias to avoid missing bullish momentum."
  ]
}
